title: SurfacePlan
description: What was painted, and how to turn it into a material: the drawing contexts that were filled, how much world one tile of them covers, and how the surface takes light.

pixels.description: Size of each map that was painted, in pixels: [width, height].

metres.description: How much world one tile covers: [width, height]. Divide the surface you are covering by this to get the texture repeat.

maps.description: The drawing contexts that were painted, by map name. Whatever the canvas factory returned.

emissive.description: What glows in the dark. Black is unlit. Read as sRGB.

lit.description: Facade only: how many windows have a light on.

signColour.description: What colour a sign burns. On a facade it is set only where the place has one lit over its door, so a light put there can match it.
